proof_scope: Pinned primary-source audit only; no phone execution.

Initializes fwspec then delegates to of_xlate; does not append stream IDs.
fwspec allocation is zeroed; num_ids remains0 until explicitly added.
Explicit add_ids updates array/count; unused by the Apple DART xlate path.
Provider remove runs hw_reset before IRQ free, IOMMU unregister and clocks disable.

decision: Validate exact owned OF map, empty Apple fwspec/provider/flags, and core domain; label map SID separately from private SID observation.
inference: A validated OF mapping to SID0 supplies args SID0 to the pinned xlate routine. This is source-based inference, not direct live private-state or physical DMA proof.
